  • Confirm the domain's age, since newly registered sites need extra attention.

Mistakes Worth Avoiding on Reef Fundcrect

Most of the losses with automated trading tools trace back to user decisions, not the platform itself. A few worth flagging:

Assuming the name means the platform is established.

Polished branding does not identify the operator. Check the operator and the licence yourself.

Funding well beyond the minimum right away.

Watch the platform, test a small withdrawal, and only then add more money.

Treating AI-assisted trading as fully hands-off.

Check your open positions regularly. Market conditions evolve, so settings need regular review.

Ignoring fees and spreads.

Small costs on every trade mount up across a reasonable number of trades. Read the current terms first.

Skipping a small test withdrawal.

Payout rules are easy to miss until you need to withdraw. Make a small test withdrawal while the balance is still small.
